heroBody: On-site, expert and affordable repairs for your PC, Mac and laptop, anywhere in Brisbane. Open every day from 7 AM to 10 PM, holidays included. No call out fees.
introBody: We cover the Greater Brisbane area, including Logan, Ipswich, Moreton and Redland Bay. We do not have technicians on the Sunshine Coast at the moment.

services.title: Virus & Malware
services.body: Infections removed and the system hardened so it stays clean. Protection set up before you get it back.

services.title: Data Recovery
services.body: Failed and dead drives recovered. Photos, documents and email brought back where the hardware allows it.

services.title: Laptop & Mac Hardware
services.body: Smashed screens, blank displays, missing keys, laptops that will not power on. MacBook and iMac included.

services.title: Setup & Migration
services.body: New machines configured and old ones moved across, so everything is where you left it.

whyUs.title: Open 7 AM to 10 PM
whyUs.body: Every day of the year, holidays included. Weekends and late nights carry no extra surcharge.

whyUs.title: No Fix, No Fee
whyUs.body: No call out fees, no travel fees, no hidden charges. If we cannot fix it, you do not pay.

whyUs.title: Usually Done In An Hour
whyUs.body: Most repairs are finished within the first hour, whether that is in the workshop or at your place.

whyUs.title: As Seen On Channel 9
whyUs.body: We were interviewed by Channel 9 about slow internet speeds around Brisbane.

ctaBody: Tell us what is going wrong and we will come back with a price to fix it.
